name: journey-atlas
description: Render a print-ready keepsake map of a road trip — driving route, ferries, overnight stays, sights, weather and zoomed-in blow-ups — from a single JSON file, over any of 15 basemaps.
//: Tasks live in deno.json — run `deno task <name>` (this project is Deno 2 first). These npm aliases just delegate to Deno so `npm run <name>` keeps working; they require the Deno CLI on PATH. package.json stays as the npm-dependency manifest that both Deno and the Vite/SvelteKit toolchain read.
